Vector, axial-vector and mixed chiral labels specify fermion currents. rows.lagrangian: L = g4 X_mu Z_nu partial^nu Z^mu + g5 epsilon^munurs X_mu Z_nu partial_r Z_s; g4,g5 are real dimensionless couplings. Metric +---, epsilon convention fixed by vertex g4 [(P.e1)(eX.e2)+(P.e2)(eX.e1)] + g5 epsilon(eX,e1,e2,q1-q2), P=q1+q2. Both tensors are Bose symmetric. In the neutral-current CP convention X_mu(t,x) -> -X^mu(t,-x) and Z_mu(t,x) -> -Z^mu(t,-x), g4 violates CP and g5 conserves CP for every spin-1 coupling class. Vector/axial labels specify fermion currents, not a restriction to CP-conserving bosonic couplings. Includes the ZZ factor 1/2 and initial polarization average 1/3; no off-shell or massless extrapolation.
